text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin got injured during training,
so I brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay, really.
It's nothing serious, so please don't worry."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
The treatment's all done,
so let's hurry back to training!
choice_data_list: Are you really going to be all right?
Are you really going to be all right?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Of course! It barely hurts at all anymore!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, I'll definitely feel better if I run!
See, I just love running so much♪"
choice_data_list: I'm worried about you, so make sure to get some proper rest.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Jeez, you're exaggerating. I might not look it, but I'm super strong, you know?
choice_data_list: Still, what if it gets worse...?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ugh. When you make a face like that...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I understand. I don't want to make you worry, so I'll rest up for today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin sounded a little disappointed
as she headed back to the dorm.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
As expected~! You really understand!
Well then, let's head out to the track right away!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While having her do a light jog,
Ines Fujin's face contorted in pain.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ugh... I might not be totally okay after all...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, even after talking so big...
It looks like I really can't do it today...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin gave up on training
and returned to the dorm looking crestfallen.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. Just a light jog
doesn't seem to be a problem.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Even though I got hurt,
I'm just so happy I can keep training without giving in.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mindful of her injury, Ines Fujin
trained within reasonable limits.
